aminoacyl-tRNAs, the charged tRNAs that are the substrates of the ribosome, have a major effect on ribosome structure in situ in vivo.

ribosomal subunits are spatially separated by approximately 3.1 nm in amino acid-starved cells, but not in exponentially growing cells, which have a compact ribosomal structure.
